newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Blast kills one, injures two in central Moscow.
newsitem.headline: Blast kills one, injures two in central Moscow.

text.p: A blast in central Moscow killed one person and injured two on Friday, police sources said.
The explosion, in a courtyard adjoining buildings containing a police station and commercial offices, shattered windows up to the fifth floor, they said.
The blast occurred shortly before midday on Mantulinskaya Street, several streets from the White House government building.
Interfax news agency quoted police sources as saying the explosion had been caused by a radio-controlled device, according to preliminary findings.
There was no immediate information on the target of the blast, but bombings by mafia-style groups are a frequent occurrence in the new Russia's cut-throat business world.
